title: Nice attractive utensil holder
text: Nice attractive utensil holder. This is an attractive utensil holder, beautiful blue color it matches my decor perfectly. Looks like it is well made, I love the finish on the outside which makes it easy to clean if any grease splashes. If I had any complaints at all it's that I wish it had a wider circumference to fit all of my utensils (I ended up putting several in one of my kitchen drawers as they wouldn't fit.. But, it is really nice and definitely adds to the look of my kitchen.
